findings.statement: Veto is exactly 0 for at most two first values and <= -70 for three or more ... a penalty of -70 or more (-269 with all five)
findings.evidence: with three first values the veto is between -58.2 and -93.3, not <= -70: the weakest triple (a1, a4, a6) gives pre-activation 5.6 and id_suppress = -11.11*5.6 + 4.00 = -58.2; maximum id_suppress when 274 fires is -58.2 over the grid. The rest reproduces: 274 > 0 exactly when 3+ of a1,a2,a3,a4,a6 are first (112 train rows), increments 7.2-9.7 on base -19.2, -269 with all five, ablation accuracy 0.887 -> 0.562
